headline: The first presidential Thanksgiving
post_facts: Lincoln's 1863 Thanksgiving fell on the same date

scenes.text: [warmly] On this day, in seventeen eighty-nine... Americans marked their first Thanksgiving under the new Constitution.

scenes.label: National Archives
scenes.caption: Washington's proclamation, October 1789
scenes.text: [calmly] At Congress's request, George Washington named this Thursday a day of thanksgiving.

scenes.label: years later, Lincoln picked the same date
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Seventy-four years later, Abraham Lincoln's Thanksgiving fell on this very same date.

scenes.label: Wall Street, New York
scenes.caption: Federal Hall, home of the first Congress, 1789
scenes.text: [softly] Lincoln made it a yearly national holiday... the one we still celebrate.

scenes.title: What are you thankful for?
scenes.text: [gently] What are you thankful for this year?
